cases.title: Original source revision and manifest continuity
cases.next_owner_step: Locate existing production release and manifest provenance; reconcile the deployed revision and exact handler without rerunning earlier scripts.

cases.title: Original owner issuer and independent witness
cases.next_owner_step: Review prior original-host public fingerprints and signed owner and witness records; never copy private keys, passwords or bearer tokens.

cases.title: Independent D1 and R2 recovery evidence
cases.next_owner_step: Review original backup inventories, retention, isolated restore and rollback receipts; do not restore production or treat a HEAD probe as recovery.

cases.title: One-source signed QL365D TEST and durable replay boundary
cases.next_owner_step: Reconcile previously approved one-source TEST receipt against the original source and receiver; seek supervised authorization only for evidence that is genuinely missing.

cases.title: AI Data Platform redacted monitoring audience
cases.next_owner_step: Review existing AI Data audience and source-health scope; do not infer permission to access orders, staff, payroll, customers or device actions.

cases.title: Comms consent, notifications and incident audience
cases.next_owner_step: Review the original Comms consent and incident route separately from AI Data monitoring; do not send or enable notifications.

cases.title: Independent single-source Master Shell acceptance
cases.next_owner_step: Review a single actual Devil n Dove acceptance decision against all original receipts; leave other five applications to their own source owners.
